title: Fixed-shift factorial ratio
statement: For natural numbers $m$ and $d$, define the fixed-shift factorial ratio to be $\displaystyle\prod_{i=0}^{3d-1}\frac{m+i+1}{m+3d+i+1}$, where an empty product is $1$.
